title: Who Gives A Hoot
author: Don Flaherty
problems: Couples don't end the round where the progression puts them (with 3 couples).
choices: Pass through goes by right shoulders.
A pass through from a ring goes along the set, to the dancer on your own side.
Square through: each balance takes 4 beats and each pull by 2.
